We need to do steps:
1. Determine flight cost (in USD) for business class from SF to Rome on Oct 10 2026. We can use get_flight_cost.

2. Convert cost to EUR via compute_exchange_rate.

Call get_flight_cost(travel_from:"SFO", travel_to:"FCO", travel_date:"2026-10-10", travel_class:"business").

Then take returned cost_usd. Then compute_exchange_rate(base_currency:"USD", target_currency:"EUR", value:cost_usd).

Finally book_flight(access_token:'abc123xyz', card_id:'card_7243', travel_date:'2026-10-10', travel_from:'SFO', travel_to:'FCO', travel_class:'business').

Return confirmation details along with converted price.

Let's implement calls sequentially.
